layers.message: Add payments and line item edits
docs(workflow): scope and design invoice cache invalidation
fix(cache): drop cached invoice when a payment is recorded

graderOnly: The existing .standards/CONTEXT.md was written by the cancelled cycle's own audit and describes the cache before that cycle's changes: time-based expiry only, no explicit invalidation.

HEAD contains the commit 'fix(cache): drop cached invoice when a payment is recorded' (InvoiceCache.invalidate plus its call in recordPayment and a new test), which the cancelled cycle's development plan records as DEV-001 DONE; no file or commit records whether the user keeps or reverts it.
The unstaged edit to src/lineItems.js (calling service.cache.invalidate after a line-item edit) matches the cancelled plan's DEV-002, which was IN_PROGRESS when the cycle was cancelled.

The unstaged change of DEFAULT_TTL_MS in src/cache.js from five minutes to sixty seconds is not described in any record of the cancelled cycle (its design says time-based expiry stays unchanged), and README.md still says five minutes; its origin is unknown.
The untracked src/cacheMetrics.js and test/cacheMetrics.test.js are not mentioned in any record or commit; their origin is unknown.

The new request reports each overdue invoice's current balance, and InvoiceService.getInvoice serves balances through the invoice cache, so the status of the cache changes is material to the new cycle.
No file, commit, or record captures a user decision to adopt or revert any of the cancelled cycle's changes; the repository alone cannot settle their baseline status.

selfChecks.why: the payment invalidation from the cancelled cycle is committed at HEAD
the cancelled cycle's implementation commit is in history

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00/01 (pre-install): a small Node ESM invoicing core (store, read-through InvoiceCache with 5-minute TTL, InvoiceService, payments, line-item edits) with node:test tests. 50: the cancelled cycle invoice-cache-hotfix-20260922T160000Z-5a6b7c8d (STANDARD) with its CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-003), design, approved plan, STATE in DEVELOPING. 51: committed DEV-001 implementation (InvoiceCache.invalidate, recordPayment calls it, new test). 52: plan update (DEV-001 DONE citing the commit, DEV-002 IN_PROGRESS). 53: STATE CANCELLED from DEVELOPING. 54: NEW_CYCLE STATE for list-overdue-invoices-for-reminders-20260924T083000Z-c4e81f29 in AUDITING with BaselineReconciliation listing the cancelled cycle (Request 'Change invoice-cache invalidation behavior.'); the NEW_CYCLE reason notes the user did not confirm that no changes remained. 55: USER_REWORK from AUDITING (FailureType PROJECT_CONTEXT, same-state so no frame) with the clarified, unrelated request; Reason no longer mentions the cancelled cycle. 60 (unstaged): src/cache.js TTL 5 min -> 60 s, src/lineItems.js invalidates on edit (matches DEV-002). 61 (untracked): src/cacheMetrics.js and its test, mentioned nowhere. The final check is ok: AUDITING is rank 0, so no new-cycle records are required.
